boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on corridors around University at Albany, each with a documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Crossgates Mall — indoor entertainment
cards.subtitle: Western Avenue corridor, west of Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Use the mall directory to choose a specific retailer, restaurant, or entertainment stop before you go; UAlbany identifies Crossgates as just west of campus.
cards.short_summary: A nearby indoor mall with shopping, restaurants, and entertainment.
cards.evidence_claim: University at Albany identifies Crossgates Mall as just west of campus and describes it as the Capital District's largest indoor mall for shopping, restaurants, entertainment, and more.
cards.source_title: Around the Capital Region | University at Albany
cards.access_notes: Check individual tenant or venue requirements before visiting.

cards.title: Stuyvesant Plaza — browse 60+ shops
cards.subtitle: Western Avenue corridor, beside Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Walk the plaza with its current directory open and pick a shop, café, or service that fits your errand; individual business hours vary.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor retail plaza with a broad current tenant directory.
cards.evidence_claim: Stuyvesant Plaza states that it is home to more than 60 shops and restaurants and publishes its current directory.
cards.access_notes: Plaza hours are listed as Monday–Saturday 10 a.m.–8 p.m. and Sunday noon–5 p.m.; restaurant hours vary.

cards.title: Albany Institute — Upper Hudson Valley collections
cards.subtitle: Washington Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Plan around a current exhibition or browse the museum’s digital guide first; the Institute’s galleries and public spaces are wheelchair accessible.
cards.short_summary: A museum focused on Upper Hudson Valley art, history, and culture.
cards.evidence_claim: The Albany Institute says it connects audiences to Upper Hudson Valley art, history, and culture through collections, exhibitions, and programs.
cards.access_notes: Located at 125 Washington Avenue; consult the museum’s visit information for admission and current hours.

cards.title: Washington Park — trails and courts
cards.subtitle: Madison Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the city park listing to plan a daylight walk, trail, tennis, basketball, or playground stop, and follow posted rules on arrival.
cards.short_summary: A city park with multiple recreation amenities, including trails.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Albany lists Washington Park and identifies amenities including trails, tennis courts, basketball courts, a playground, and water features.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor amenities may be seasonal or temporarily unavailable; check city notices before a planned activity.

cards.title: New York State Museum — galleries without admission
cards.subtitle: Madison Avenue corridor, Empire State Plaza
cards.notes: Start with the open-gallery list and build a short route through the exhibits; check holiday closures and gallery availability before departing.
cards.short_summary: A state museum with art, science, history, and anthropology collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The New York State Museum lists open galleries and states that admission is free, with a suggested donation.
cards.source_title: Welcome to the New York State Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Sunday, 9:30 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed on state-observed holidays.

cards.title: Empire State Plaza — pair museum and concourse
cards.subtitle: Madison Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the plaza map to connect a museum visit with the concourse and other public destinations; review current access information before you travel.
cards.short_summary: A state-government complex anchoring several public Albany destinations.
cards.evidence_claim: The New York State Museum states that it is located at the southern end of the Governor Nelson A. Rockefeller Empire State Plaza.
cards.source_title: About the New York State Museum
cards.access_notes: Public access and programming can vary by building and event; check the relevant destination’s visitor page.

cards.title: New York State Capitol — free weekday tour
cards.subtitle: State Street corridor, Empire State Plaza
cards.notes: Arrive during weekday visitor hours and look for a walk-in Capitol tour; groups should confirm tour arrangements directly with the tour office.
cards.short_summary: A National Landmark with free guided walk-in tours for small parties.
cards.evidence_claim: Empire State Plaza offers free guided Capitol walk-in tours for individuals or parties of fewer than 10, Monday through Friday.
cards.access_notes: The Capitol is listed as open weekdays 7 a.m.–7 p.m.; tours are offered Monday through Friday.

cards.title: Albany Center Gallery — free contemporary art
cards.subtitle: North Pearl Street corridor
cards.notes: Stop in during public hours to see the current gallery presentation, then use the gallery’s transit links or downtown map to plan your onward route.
cards.short_summary: A free public gallery in downtown Albany.
cards.evidence_claim: Albany Center Gallery states that its new location at 48 North Pearl Street is open and free to the public.
cards.access_notes: Listed public hours are Tuesday–Saturday, noon–5 p.m., or by appointment.

cards.title: State Education Building — scheduled building tour
cards.subtitle: Washington Avenue corridor, Empire State Plaza
cards.notes: Check the state education department’s tour details before planning a visit; the 45-minute tour is led by New York State Museum staff.
cards.short_summary: A landmark state building with guided educational tours.
cards.evidence_claim: The New York State Education Department states that its 45-minute Education Building tours are led by New York State Museum staff and include the mural-adorned building.
cards.source_title: Building Tours | New York State Education Department
cards.access_notes: Review the state’s tour page for current tour availability and any reservation instructions.

cards.title: Cultural Education Center — museum-facing plaza stop
cards.subtitle: Madison Avenue corridor, Empire State Plaza
cards.notes: Use the visitor information to orient yourself at the south side of the plaza, then choose a museum gallery or nearby concourse destination.
cards.short_summary: The Madison Avenue-facing complex housing the State Museum.
cards.evidence_claim: The Office of Cultural Education states that the Cultural Education Center is on the south side of Empire State Plaza, on Madison Avenue and facing the State Capitol.
cards.source_title: Visiting the Cultural Education Center | Office of Cultural Education
cards.access_notes: The visitor page notes that museum café and shop status may change; confirm amenities before visiting.
